newsitem.title: USA: Barshefsky says voiced trade worries to Japan aide.
newsitem.headline: Barshefsky says voiced trade worries to Japan aide.

text.p: U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshefsky voiced continued concern on Friday over the recent rise in Japan's current account surplus.
"We certainly hope that Japan is right and this is a temporary blip," she told reporters following the signing of a trade deal with the European Union.
Barshefsky said she also voiced concern about a number of specific trade issus in a 45-minute meeting with Japan's Trade Minister Shinji Sato on Friday.
Barshefsky cited Japan's "slow progress" on deregulating car parts trade, expanding U.S. auto dealerships and opening up its glass and paper markets.
Barshefsky said she thought Sato had gotten the message that it must speed up progress in implementing the two countries' car trade pact.
